name: basic_fetch_and_rebase
assertions: fetches latest refs from the remote
rebases the current branch onto the updated upstream
preserves local commits on top of upstream changes
reports the rebase result with updated commit range

name: pull_rebase_trigger
assertions: recognizes 'pull --rebase' as a fetch-rebase intent
fetches from the default remote
rebases onto the specified branch (main)
does NOT create merge commits

name: custom_remote_branch_args
assertions: uses 'upstream' as the remote
targets 'release/2.0' as the branch to rebase onto
fetches the specified remote before rebasing
rebases current branch onto upstream/release/2.0

name: uncommitted_changes_handling
input: rebase onto latest main, I have uncommitted changes
assertions: detects uncommitted changes in the working directory
offers options: stash changes, abort, or proceed
if stashing, restores stashed changes after successful rebase
does NOT silently discard uncommitted work
warns about potential conflicts with stashed changes

name: conflict_resolution_guidance
input: fetch and rebase, there might be conflicts
assertions: proceeds with the fetch and rebase operation
detects rebase conflicts if they occur
provides guidance on resolving each conflict
explains how to continue (git rebase --continue) or abort (git rebase --abort)

name: negative_push_intent
input: push my rebased changes to remote
assertions: does NOT trigger the fr skill
recognizes push intent belongs to /sync or /cp
does NOT perform a fetch or rebase operation

name: negative_fast_forward_intent
assertions: does NOT trigger the fr skill
recognizes fast-forward as a different operation (/ff)
does NOT perform a rebase

name: update_feature_branch
input: update my feature branch with the latest from main
assertions: fetches latest main from remote
rebases the current feature branch onto origin/main
maintains a linear commit history
reports the number of commits replayed
